audit.why: 53% win rate over 3364 games with Garen ahead through First item and Galio taking 2+ items matches diff FAV / 5.5-6 ratings. The mirror (galio__garen) recorded that no stage was moved; I did not move any either.
audit.corrected: Level chart left as-is: Garen L1-L5 and First item, Skill at 6, Galio at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike/commit text referred to a placeholder blob, 'Galio shield taunt wind-up and heroic map entries', instead of the real spikes.
audit.why: Galio's actual lane spikes are Shield of Durand (W) coming online for the taunt and Justice Punch (E) at 11/10/9/8/7s; Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s and is a map tool, not a duel spike. Garen's own spikes are Courage (W) at 22s rank 1 and Decisive Strike (Q) at a flat 8s.
audit.corrected: focus.text and the do's now name Shield of Durand (W) charge and Justice Punch (E) as the tracked spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gave Justice Punch a 13s cooldown; nothing stated that Decisive Strike's silence denies Galio's casts, and the Colossal Smash (P) auto-reset tell and the no-dash retreat problem were absent.
audit.why: Riot data has Justice Punch at 11/10/9/8/7s. Decisive Strike silences, which denies Winds of War (Q) and the Shield of Durand release. Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not a cast bar, is the tell. Galio's E is a dash that can cut off a retreat and Garen has no dash of his own.
audit.corrected: Real 11s/7s cooldown written in, silence-denies-casts stated in the commit line, the P wind-up tell added to Common Mistakes, and the no-dash/Flash-for-the-E point added to the don'ts.
